description: This file defines interfaces and prototypes for custom log output formatting in Zephyr OS, including functions for processing log messages, setting custom formatters, and handling timestamps.

methods.name: log_custom_output_msg_process
methods.description: Processes log messages using an external output function.

methods.name: log_custom_output_msg_set
methods.description: Sets the external formatter function for log output.

methods.name: log_custom_timestamp_print
methods.description: Formats and prints a timestamp using a custom function.

methods.name: log_custom_timestamp_set
methods.description: Sets the timestamp formatting function for custom timestamp output.
